name: Down the Scarlet Path
label: Quest
description: Brother Anton of the Scarlet Crusade, at Nijel's Point, says his order is at war with the Scourge, an evil that corrupts the people and infects the land.…
intro: Brother Anton of the Scarlet Crusade, at Nijel's Point, says his order is at war with the Scourge, an evil that corrupts the people and infects the land. He asks you to prove your allegiance by destroying thirty undead ravagers in the Valley of Bones.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I will be frank. We are at war with the Scourge. It is an evil that corrupts our people and infects our land. It must be stopped before it overwhelms us and drags our world into shadow. We of the Scarlet Crusade have sworn to fight the Scourge with body and soul.
If you are with us, then gather your courage and prove your allegiance--destroy the undead ravagers of Desolace, in the Valley of Bones to the south.
Do this, and the Crusade will embrace you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Scourge grows in power with the passing of each day. If you truly wish to halt its advances, then show me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have proven your resolve, and the Scarlet Crusade commends you.
If you do not shy from righteous slaughter, then perhaps your path lies with us...
